name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline from a task or an issue to reviewed, completed work: slicing and building behind one planning gate, local review by two independent engines consolidated into one coverage-checked report, completion by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request), the forge's issue tracker, handing work across sessions, surveying a backlog slice against the code, fanning an epic out to parallel sessions in waves, and git cleanup.
